title: aquilegia canadensis subsp. flavescens
intro: Aquilegia canadensis subsp. flavescens, commonly known as yellow columbine, is a plant species native to North America, characterized by its bright yellow flowers and feathery foliage. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Aquilegia canadensis subsp. flavescens include anti-hypertensive, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
